item.text:
Android’s “Remove animations” setting should make Pip use calm variants: unchanged timing and cues, half the squash, feet lifting at most 5% of body height, and no flips or turns over 30°. Big transitions—travel over one-third of the screen or scale changes over 10%—become crossfades lasting at most 150 ms; the hint ring and dream cloud stay still. Yes: the listening ear glow still pulses every 1.6 seconds, even with reduced motion enabled.
